title: Türkiye Hosts Libyan National Army Chief of Staff
excerpt: Türkiye's defence ministry says the Chief of the General Staff is hosting the Libyan National Army's chief of staff and his delegation on 12 November.
rank_math_title: Türkiye hosts Libyan National Army chief of staff
rank_math_description: Türkiye's Chief of the General Staff is hosting the Libyan National Army chief of staff and delegation on 12 November, a day after a phone call with the LNA.
